latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Hailuo AI Free — generate AI videos from text or image prompts, no subscription required.

- Instantly connect to cloud backend for AI video generation with free credits.
- Accepts text, JPG, PNG, WEBP, and MP4 uploads up to 200MB.
- Supports easy prompt-based 1080p, 5-second video clip creation.
- Clean chat workflow: upload, describe, and export your AI video in 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic session/token management, with clear guidance and robust error handling.
- Designed for content creators who want fast, simple AI video generation for free.
